from yt_dlp.utils._utils import Config
opts=['-u','myuser','--password','mypass','--video-password=secret','extra1','--username','someone','extra2']
PRIVATE_OPTS={'-p','--password','-u','--username','--video-password','--ap-password','--ap-username'}
import re
eqre=re.compile('^(?P<key>' + ('|'.join(re.escape(po) for po in PRIVATE_OPTS)) + ')=.+$')
def _scrub_eq(o):
    m=eqre.match(o)
    return m.group('key') + '=PRIVATE' if m else o
opts=list(map(_scrub_eq, opts))
for n,(idx,opt) in enumerate(enumerate(opts), start=1):
    if n==8:
        print('EIGHTH_START', idx, opt, opts)
        break
    if opt in PRIVATE_OPTS and idx + 1 < len(opts):
        opts[idx+1]='PRIVATE'
print('FINAL', Config.hide_login_info(['-u','myuser','--password','mypass','--video-password=secret','extra1','--username','someone','extra2']))
PY
